<subject>Maple & Crown Network Expansion for Years 2000/2001</subject>
<body>
Since Shirley and I are planning to be at the Calgary Data Centre tomorrow, we are providing you our laundry list of year end Network Engineering items for discussion at your meeting tomorrow.

FYI, if we have more items than you need in total, the items I would prefer to pull back first would be the FibreLink Solutions payment, the CRTC compliance user fees, and the capitalization of specialized overheads.








Please let us know how you wish to proceed.
